title: Tor from an exact periodic unit pair
statement: Let φ:R→S be a coefficient-ring-sheaf map on the pro-etale site. Suppose unit endomorphisms f,g form an exact alternating pair and a normalized unit epimorphism p:R→Resφ(S) identifies its kernel with the image of g. If f and g kill Resφ(N), then H^i(Lφ_!(Resφ(N)[0]))≅N for every i≤0.

source.place: Order 1429, residue counterexample in (1); normalized tensor and periodic free resolutions, Stacks Tags 06YU and 0118.

proof.text: Identify the cokernel of g with the restricted quotient unit using the exact normalized epimorphism. Use the alternating K-flat unit resolution. Tensoring with the restricted N kills both differentials. Compare this tensor model with the specified derived extension using a K-flat resolution of N and the double tensor complex; both augmentation maps are quasi-isomorphisms. The ordinary tensor-extension comparison and universal counit give the desired model, and fully faithful exact quotient restriction lifts the cohomology isomorphisms.
